picks.title: Bluecore Energy raises $10M to build portable nuclear reactors on barges
picks.why_it_matters: A $10M pre-seed for maritime nuclear energy signals deep tech climate infrastructure is attracting serious early capital, and the Uber founder pedigree suggests operator-founders are moving into hard tech energy plays.

picks.title: Jack Dorsey launches Buzz to combine team chat, AI agents and Git hosting
picks.why_it_matters: A high-profile founder entering the AI-native developer tools space validates the thesis that agentic workflows will reshape how engineering teams collaborate, creating both competition and acquisition opportunities for startups in this category.

picks.title: Judge approves $1.5B Anthropic settlement for pirated books used to train Claude
picks.why_it_matters: This landmark settlement establishes a costly precedent for training data liability, making data provenance and licensing infrastructure an increasingly urgent investment opportunity for AI startups.
